name: Would you help me draw a picture?
source:
Follow the life of a young artist and her struggle to finish her picture without the help of her brother. 

An interactive visual novel with a unique dark tone and two separate endings. Would you manage to help her finish her drawing?

[From [url=https://slavomir.itch.io/would-you-help-me-draw-a-picture]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
讲述一位年轻艺术家的生活，以及她在没有哥哥帮助的情况下努力完成自己的画作的故事。

一部互动视觉小说，具有独特的暗色调和两个独立的结局。你能帮她完成她的画吗？

[来自[url=https://slavomir.itch.io/would-you-help-me-draw-a-picture]Itch.io[/url]]
